verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is a state business-filing service that collects user-submitted data, so a privacy question about AI-training use of that data is a fair one to ask. The evidence pack covers only filing, payment, annual-report and records features, with no mention of AI-training policy or an opt-out. The robots.txt probe concerns crawler access to the filing host, not whether users can keep their data out of model training, so it does not count.
